title: Suno Prompt Engineering Guide: co-existing style data
reported_observation: The repository advertises raw co_existing_styles.json and default_styles.json datasets and invites contributors to submit observations with generation counts and time periods.
creator_interpretation: Potential source for a style co-occurrence network. Methodology, source provenance, coverage, license and representativeness must be audited before analysis.
our_hypothesis: Co-occurring style labels may reveal community prompt habits or platform metadata relationships. They do not directly expose Suno's token embeddings, neural associations or model weights.
limitations: Research capture summary, not a full audit of the source.
Community observations are self-reported unless otherwise specified.
Do not infer Suno's proprietary architecture from these observations.
rights_and_terms: Not assessed. Retain canonical source link; do not redistribute source code, datasets, audio or full copyrighted text without a compatible license or permission.
access_notes: Public search result/page. Minimal metadata and summary only.
